_comment: Module 5.1: ESCO role-aware phrase → skill map, applied by the ESCO import as a transform (app/services/professions/esco_role_map.py). Keyed by occupation URI + skill URI; labels are for reading only. skills = 0–8 canonical names from app/data/skill_descriptions.json; an empty list is a reviewed pair that stays unmapped. Made AI-assisted, role-aware and conservative; user spot-check 40/40. Validated by AIServices/scripts/check_esco_role_map.py. Never edited by publishing.
method: AI-assisted (Claude), role-aware, conservative; spot-check 40/40 (Wilson 95 % lower bound ~91 %)
